_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Verification, Demonstration, and Evaluation Plan
summary: Describes the contractor's program for verifying, demonstrating, and evaluating the maintenance and logistic support characteristics of the system, providing Government visibility into the Integrated Product Support (IPS) program.
use_relationship:
The Verification, Demonstration, and Evaluation Plan describes the contractor's program for verifying, demonstrating, and evaluating the maintenance and logistic support characteristics of the system. The plan provides Government visibility to the contractor's approach for assessing the Integrated Product Support (IPS) program.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

This DID supersedes DI-MNTY-81188.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Verification, Demonstration, and Evaluation Plan shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Verification, Demonstration, and Evaluation Plan shall describe the contractor's three-phase program for providing progressive assurance that the IPS contractual requirements have been met. The plan shall cover the verification, demonstration, and evaluation program identified in the contract statement of work. The plan shall include the following:

children.title: Data recording rules and assessment techniques
Number of units and mission mix as appropriate
Procedures to compensate for differences in demonstration environment from operational environment
The availability of units and support elements for testing
Effort directed to evaluating specific support elements
children.content: (e.g., technical manuals, repair parts, facilities, ground support equipment, etc.)

children.title: Ground rules to be followed in conducting the demonstration
